term: individual weak possible causal availability for obtaining contingent facts
definition: For each fact f that is contingent at v under existing PSRStrength.Contingent, some world u accessible from v satisfies ActualCausedFact A Concrete CauseFact u f. Fact identity f is retained, but its cause and world may vary. No joint causal sufficiency or actual-world universal causal PSR is asserted.
note: Source-free typed profile over the unchanged PSRStrength.Arena and its Ontic. No source attribution or applicability is established. Existing fact/individual/world domains remain distinct; no fact is reified as a being.
